statement: For the selected finite qutrit Weyl response algebra, the normalized trace/Frobenius C1 measure is forced by Weyl-conjugation invariance and irreducibility, so the measure-normalization part of the SelectedFiniteC1TraceMeasurePrinciple is not a free patch knob. The remaining unpatched gap is physical: prove that Phi_fin^C1/action restricts to this finite quotient with no extra boundary/source term and emits the same-source b_selected/R_Z/R_X data.
